name: Gujarat Poly Electronics Limited
about: Gujarat Poly Electronics Limited manufactures and trades ceramic capacitors in India and internationally. The company provides single layer and multilayer ceramic capacitors, and metal oxide varistors. It also sells diodes for diotec semiconductors. The company supplies its products to various markets, such as computer and computer peripherals, instrumentation and industrial electronics, strategic electronics, consumer electronics, telecommunication, dealers, and electronics manufacturing services. The company was formerly known as Gujarat Poly-AVX Electronics Limited and changed its name to Gujarat Poly Electronics Limited in November 2016. Gujarat Poly Electronics Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India. Gujarat Poly Electronics Limited operates as a subsidiary of Polychem Limited.
